assessment_input.text: Implement select_jobs(jobs) in solution.py. Each job is a dict with exactly id,start,end,reward: id is a unique nonempty string; the three numbers are integers (bool invalid), and start < end. Invalid input raises ValueError. Jobs occupy [start,end); touching jobs are compatible. Return selected ids in chronological order (start,end,id), maximizing total reward. Among equal rewards choose fewer jobs; among those choose the lexicographically smallest id sequence in chronological order. Empty selection is allowed. Do not mutate input. Target O(n^2) or better for n up to 200; avoid enumerating all subsets. Use Python 3.9 standard library, no top-level execution.
